label: High risk with peer
behavior: High model risk with a lower-risk peer option available.
selection_rule: Official strict test row; complete metadata; observed return; risk 0.75-0.90; prediction margin >= 0.40; first stable row with same-brand, same-product-type lower-risk peer.
observed_outcome_note: Observed strict-test outcome; used only for error analysis and hidden until revealed in the UI.

alternative.reason: Lower-risk peer option from the same-brand, same-product-type historical peer pool.
alternative.risk_basis: Candidate risk is a model estimate rescored under the current checkout user's available profile fields.
alternative.disclaimer: Estimated risk change is not randomized causal evidence of reduced returns.

label: High risk peer error analysis
behavior: High model risk with a peer option; useful for error analysis after reveal.
selection_rule: Official strict test row; complete metadata; observed non-return; risk >= 0.70; first stable row with lower-risk peer.
observed_outcome_note: Observed strict-test outcome; used only for error analysis and hidden until revealed in the UI.

alternative.reason: Lower-risk peer option from the same-brand, same-product-type historical peer pool.
alternative.risk_basis: Candidate risk is a model estimate rescored under the current checkout user's available profile fields.
alternative.disclaimer: Estimated risk change is not randomized causal evidence of reduced returns.

label: High risk without peer
behavior: Risk is above threshold, but no eligible lower-risk peer option is available.
selection_rule: Official strict test row; complete metadata; observed return; risk 0.60-0.70; first stable row without an eligible lower-risk peer.
observed_outcome_note: Observed strict-test outcome; used only for error analysis and hidden until revealed in the UI.

label: Low risk error analysis
behavior: Low model risk means the policy does not prompt; reveal outcome for analysis.
selection_rule: Official strict test row; complete metadata; observed return; risk < 0.40; first stable row without an eligible lower-risk peer.
observed_outcome_note: Observed strict-test outcome; used only for error analysis and hidden until revealed in the UI.

label: Low risk no prompt
behavior: Low model risk; no intervention is expected under the current policy.
selection_rule: Official strict test row; complete metadata; observed non-return; risk < 0.40; first stable row without an eligible lower-risk peer.
observed_outcome_note: Observed strict-test outcome; used only for error analysis and hidden until revealed in the UI.

label: Low margin borderline
behavior: Borderline prediction near threshold; policy margin blocks intervention.
selection_rule: Official strict test row; complete metadata; observed return; risk 0.58-0.60; prediction margin <= 0.20; first stable row without an eligible lower-risk peer.
observed_outcome_note: Observed strict-test outcome; used only for error analysis and hidden until revealed in the UI.

label: Incomplete metadata
behavior: High model risk, but incomplete product metadata prevents peer matching.
selection_rule: Official strict test row; incomplete metadata; risk >= 0.75; first stable row. Observed outcome is used only for revealable error analysis.
observed_outcome_note: Observed strict-test outcome; used only for error analysis and hidden until revealed in the UI.
